correctness.rationale: Binary and ternary quadratic-character sums are derived for all target cases; explicit exclusion of each zero coordinate computes exact prime-level counts. Nonsingular derivative 2b gives exactly p² lifts per odd-prime-power level. The unit-square group and CRT establish dyadic and composite formulas. Three possible Legendre cases establish all minima. Independently implemented exact test passed 575 parameter/modulus profiles and all minima through p=47.

Classical characters provide underlying methods, so equivalent unindexed computations remain a material risk.
